visor.broke: Your visor broke. The view will glitch until you fix it.
visor.fix: Drag the slider toward the light.
visor.fixSlide: Drag the slider toward the light.
visor.fixed:
Fixed!
Dropping the Goop faster keeps the Visor charged.

broke.keys: Your laser broke. Each zap now takes two clicks: prime, then zap.
broke.mouse: Your laser broke. Each zap now takes two clicks: prime, then zap.
broke.phone: Your laser broke. Each zap now takes two taps: prime, then zap.

laser.fix: Drag the slider toward its blinking light.
laser.fixed:
Fixed!
Zapping drains the Laser. Every piece that lands recharges it.

controls.broke: Your controls overheated. Held spins now turn the tank slowly.
controls.fix: Turn the dial to the blinking light.
controls.fixed:
Fixed!
Every spin heats the Controls. Short rests cool them.
